meta.methodology: Pay-gap ratio = latest available province-level average net wage (BPS Sakernas, employees only) divided by the region UMK (or provincial UMP where no separate UMK exists). Average wage data exists for 38 of 38 provinces and is NOT available at kabupaten/kota level, so all kabupaten/kota within a province share the same income reference figure. No median wage figures exist in the source data at any level.
